The idiom “Es zieht wie Hechtsuppe” gives Jonas’s dialogue an authentic colloquial voice, while the shadows under his eyes appearing “wie mit dem Daumen verwischt” provide a vivid, painterly image of exhaustion. More subtly, Ilse’s unnecessary crossing and claim that the chain needs tightening turn the ferry’s physical distance and tension into an understated metaphor for her guarded relationship with her son.
